martha.name: Martha
martha.comment: Martha, Friday looks perfect for a cycle, especially between 9 and 11 when it's a calm 21°C. You might even drag Britt along for a great morning ride. Temperatures will rise to 25°C later, so make the most of the cooler morning hours.

britt.name: Britt
britt.comment: Britt, perfect morning for a cycle, isn't it? The wind is calm and it's a warm 22°C, so grab your bike and hit the road between 9 and 11 for the best conditions. If Martha's free later, you could always convince her to join you for a relaxing swim, but for now, the roads are calling.
